frontier.hypothesis: A DIRECTED permuter campaign using PERM_LINESWAP around the {sum, v1, s4, i, count, s5} decl block plus PERM_GENERAL around the `a0<<4` / `s4+a1` / `*(base+v1)` expressions can escape the score-60 basin where random-mode cannot. Ledger's PERM_STMT_LIST/PERM_ADD_SUB/PERM_DUMMY_COMMA_EXPR/PERM_REORDER_DECLS are aspirational (do not exist in decomp-permuter) — PERM_LINESWAP + PERM_GENERAL are the actual usable substitutes.
frontier.mechanism: Random mode's mutations are broad but shallow; directed macros focus the search on the specific decl/expression cluster the ledger's s6/s7 pass analysis identifies as coupled to the sll/move16 sched2 tie. Fresh-seed discipline (feedback/permuter-fresh-seed-discipline) mandates that a directed sweep runs on a different chassis than the random one, so this is a genuinely un-tried search axis.
